channels.name: Network A port
channels.purpose: IEEE 802.3 link to Network A; carries one copy of every frame.

channels.name: Network B port
channels.purpose: Independent IEEE 802.3 link to Network B; carries the redundant copy.

channels.name: Host / application interface
channels.purpose: Sampling and queuing communication ports (UDP/IP) to the avionics application.

handshake_pairs.name: Replicate-A/B
handshake_pairs.rule: send every frame on both networks.

handshake_pairs.name: IC+RM
handshake_pairs.rule: per-network Integrity Check then first-valid-wins Redundancy Management.

handshake_pairs.name: Police
handshake_pairs.rule: drop frames from a VL exceeding its BAG/Lmax.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Every VL frame is replicated onto Network A and Network B; the receiver reconciles them by Sequence-Number Integrity Checking + first-valid-wins Redundancy Management.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Transmission requires the VL shaper to satisfy the BAG (within jitter); delivery requires a valid Sequence Number passing Integrity Checking on at least one network.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Virtual Link frame
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Standard Ethernet frame with VL ID in the dest MAC and a 1-byte Sequence Number before the FCS.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Replicated A/B
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: The same frame transmitted on both Network A and Network B.

ordering_rules.frame_order: Frames on a VL carry an incrementing Sequence Number; ordering/duplicate-suppression is by SN.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Full-duplex; A and B carry the same frame near-simultaneously.
